summary: Comprehensive testing of SEVORA Influencer Operations Tool completed. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate), frontend has critical SelectItem component bugs preventing full user workflows.

ui_bugs.issue: SelectItem components throughout the app have empty string values, causing React runtime errors
ui_bugs.error_message: A <SelectItem /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string. This is because the Select value can be set to an empty string to clear the selection and show the placeholder.

ui_bugs.issue: Chart components showing width(-1) and height(-1) errors, preventing proper chart rendering
ui_bugs.error_message: The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0

integration_issues.issue: SelectItem errors prevent navigation to Discovery, Campaigns, Outreach, and AI Studio pages
integration_issues.impact: Users cannot access core functionality pages

passed_tests: Frontend dashboard loading and KPI display
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix SelectItem components throughout the app - all SelectItem elements need non-empty value props. Check Discovery page filters, Campaign creation forms, Outreach channel selectors, and AI Studio components. Also fix Recharts container sizing issues on Dashboard.
